findings_closed.title: Notify and mint-notify owner requests forwarded caller overpayment into the recipient ATH wallet
findings_closed.resolution: Notify-style owner requests now forward only the canonical downstream notification envelope and return owner overpayment to the response destination instead of stranding it as unaccounted recipient wallet TON.

findings_closed.title: Owner-facing exact-minimum burn/transfer/notify reserves were accepted source-side but could fail after first-hop fees
findings_closed.resolution: Owner-facing burn, simple transfer, notify, and mint-notify requests now require an additional 2,000,000 nanotons first-hop execution reserve before debiting ATH. Burn and simple transfer forward the caller-funded remainder because their downstream callbacks return excess value; notify and mint-notify cap the forwarded value because those paths send fixed notification and ACK messages.

owner_request_policy.burn: requires burn notification reserve plus owner first-hop reserve; forwards caller-funded remainder with SendPayFwdFeesSeparately
owner_request_policy.simple_transfer: requires recipient execution reserve plus owner first-hop reserve; forwards caller-funded remainder with SendPayFwdFeesSeparately
owner_request_policy.notify_transfer: requires notify value plus ACK value plus recipient execution/storage reserves plus owner first-hop reserve; forwards only the canonical notify envelope and refunds excess
owner_request_policy.mint_username_transfer: same bounded canonical envelope and excess refund policy as notify transfer
